standard_sections.title: Section Goal
standard_sections.content: Diagnose BackupIQ/DEB failures, prefer an evidence-matched lower-impact repair over reinstall, preserve pairing, and require a fresh authoritative successful recovery point before incident completion.

standard_sections.title: Trigger
standard_sections.content: Existing open actionable same-client BackupIQ ticket. MSI1603, low space and VSS errors are diagnostic branches within that incident, not authority to scan or change unrelated devices.

standard_sections.title: Scope and Boundaries
standard_sections.content: Inherit exact requester grants, Central Orchestrator and direct_provider_access=false. No clean install, restore, provider-asset deletion, retention/encryption/audit-policy change, reboot, blanket cleanup or security-policy bypass.

standard_sections.title: Initial Identification
standard_sections.content: Shared runtime must uniquely bind ticket/company/active CI/DRMM device/provider asset, preserving a correct existing CI. Before substantive work, verify Jason/In Progress/Remote Support by PSA readback. Ambiguity blocks action. This runtime wiring remains an inherited acceptance gap.

standard_sections.title: Expected State
standard_sections.content: Backup enabled; same original agent/tenant registration; service Running; sufficient free volume space; working VSS snapshot; exact provider asset online; fresh nondegraded successful backup and no current alert.

standard_sections.title: State Model
standard_sections.content: Inherit durable detected/owned/identified/diagnosing/classified/remediating/verifying/waiting/blocked/Human Review/complete lifecycle. Persist action nonce, exact component hash, approval evidence, job/output IDs, baseline and backup ID. Missing durable continuation prevents activation.

standard_sections.title: Diagnostic Workflow
standard_sections.content: Read same-client provider state and endpoint availability independently. For online backup failure, collect MSI source/identity/signature evidence, service and native registration, physical free space, per-folder usage, Volsnap cap events, shadow association, current backup and sanitized logs through a governed diagnostic component. Interpret 1603 as generic until source evidence establishes its cause.

standard_sections.title: Decision Gates
standard_sections.content: Every new component requires exact trusted registry binding and live action authority. Caller-supplied facts cannot grant permission. No repair while backup active. An unknown diagnosis routes to Human Review; only proven no_exact_lower_impact_fix reaches existing one-reinstall gate.

standard_sections.title: Remediation
standard_sections.content: Endpoint recovery profiles define source-name alias repair, stopped-service recovery, VSS cap adjustment and separately approved cleanup. Each modifying profile requires exact-action approval and readback. One repair per incident invocation; multiple independent causes require reevaluation and separate bound actions. Shared installer remains unchanged.

standard_sections.title: Retry Policy
standard_sections.content: One diagnostic job, one repair job, one backup-now submission and the existing one-reinstall ceiling. Read the existing job on output errors rather than resubmitting. An accepted backup ID forbids another backup request; inconclusive EOF alone is not failure.

standard_sections.title: Periodic Rechecks
standard_sections.content: Shared scheduler: normal offline hourly, postrepair backup every fifteen minutes within original three-hour deadline. Persist baseline and release active slot while waiting. No duplicate jobs/notes. Existing seven-day full-backup grace requires documented advancing provider percentage; local bytes do not silently extend deadline.

standard_sections.title: Aging / Stale Condition
standard_sections.content: Offline over ten days enters stale-asset review. Postrepair timeouts and twelve-hour progress stalls require review. Time is measured from original baseline, surviving resume/restarts.

standard_sections.title: Dependency Handling
standard_sections.content: Preserve server-held per-client token/encryption dependencies. Reuse low_disk_space and security_log_self_heal as governed dependency candidates, not automatically approved cleanup. Deduplicate dependency issues and block when profiles, credentials, parser, scheduler or provider access are unavailable.

standard_sections.title: Documentation Requirements
standard_sections.content: Internal case notes only for meaningful transitions: STATUS, NEXT STEP/ACTION REQUIRED, WHEN, KEY EVIDENCE, WHAT JASON DID, CHANGES MADE, JASON STATE. Normalize note fingerprints across origins. No secrets, complete verbose MSI logs or raw Security event payloads.

standard_sections.title: Failure Handling
standard_sections.content: Distinguish provider authorization denial from authoritative empty inventory. Preserve raw MSI exit independently of RMM postcheck. Service stopped after MSI0 is not another MSI failure. Restore temporary logging policy on every exit. Unknown job results, missing output selectors and inconsistent pairing fail closed.

standard_sections.title: Escalation Criteria
standard_sections.content: Human Review for identity ambiguity, failed exact repair, missing capabilities/authority, snapshot cap not supported by evidence, policy or retention decision, duplicate/new asset, 3010 requiring reboot, failed provider read or missing fresh recovery point. Preserve original Help Desk I/Human Review readback rules.

standard_sections.title: Verification
standard_sections.content: Require fresh same-client recovery point after baseline, provider online/enabled, current alert resolved, and no degraded snapshot result. Review omissions/exclusions. Local completion, MSI0, Running service or progressing byte counter alone cannot complete a ticket.

standard_sections.title: Completion Criteria
standard_sections.content: Correct mapping, diagnosed cause, approved successful repair, fresh provider health, documented action/evidence and independently read-back terminal PSA state. Draft validation/staging is not runtime acceptance.

standard_sections.title: Final Resolution Note
standard_sections.content: Record original condition, proven cause, device/client, free-space and VSS changes, installer/source evidence, original pairing, attempts/job IDs, new recovery point/time, exclusions and verified final disposition. State pending evidence explicitly.

standard_sections.title: Required Capabilities
standard_sections.content: Existing exact provider/ticket/device reads, governed component execution and job status; add automation.job.output.read only. New component UIDs/content hashes and trusted output normalization remain explicit implementation gaps. No broad shell or direct-provider facility is embedded.

standard_sections.title: Acceptance Test
standard_sections.content: Use VZ-51624 as manual reference evidence only. Require controlled governed runtime tests for all new branches, dry-run approval denials, wrong-client rejection, existing differing alias rejection, running-backup rejection, logging rollback, registration preservation, uncertain job output, EOF accepted/nonaccepted cases, service-before-registration order, resume/no duplicate jobs or notes, provider auth failure and final PSA readback.

standard_sections.title: Section Goal Closure
standard_sections.content: Pending exact component integration/publication and governed mutation runtime acceptance. Asset and alert reads now work when bound to verified company scope; the incident recovery point and empty current-alert result are live-proven. Local branch tests are pre-activation engineering evidence, not production acceptance.

standard_sections.title: Autonomous Execution Eligibility and Owner Review
standard_sections.content: Shadow draft only, no new standing authority. Exact version/fingerprint/component/capability acceptance and durable Owner promotion are required before unattended execution. Authenticated Owner approval is permitted under Mandatory Execution Rules; Teams is not required. Existing production freeze and unrelated releases remain protected.
